newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales at $1.5 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales at $1.5 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, June 10 are expected to total $1.5 billion in 50 deals according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $648 million in 17 sales, with a $140 million Broward County SD, Fla., deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 33 sales totaling $845 million are scheduled. A $225 million Virginia Housing Development Authority issue at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional 12 sales totaling $668 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Tuesday depending on market conditions.
